frames.label: fault — fast ISP r2 knocked to LP 50, so slow r3 (LP 100) wins
frames.caption: 8.8.8.0/24 heard from both ISPs — r2 (fast) was set to LP 50, so the slow ISP r3 (LP 100) wins. Why the slow one?

frames.label: fix — set LocPref 150 on r2: the fast ISP now wins (150 > 100)
frames.caption: Raise LocPref to 150 on r2 — the fast ISP is best again (150 > 100)

frames.label: eth1 (r1–r2) down — only r3 remains
frames.caption: r1–r2 link down — 8.8.8.0/24 now has only one path, via r3

frames.label: restored — LP 150 decides again: r2 (fast) wins
frames.caption: Restored — LP 150 > 100 decides again: fast ISP r2 wins
